Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["maxDepth" => 0, "respectRobotsTxt" => false]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->statusCode);
var_dump($result->contentType);
var_dump($result->html);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->title);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->description);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->canonicalUrl);
var_dump(count($result->getLinks()));
var_dump($result->getLinks()[0]->linkType);
var_dump(count($result->getImages()));
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->ogTitle);
```
